messages.content: I want to replace the weeklong airport SUV with the shorter neighborhood rental we discussed. Check the branch hours first, then make sure rides to and from SAN line up with the American flights.

The Enterprise Mission Valley branch has a standard SUV available from June 22 through June 25. It is open 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. on both dates, and after-hours returns are allowed, but the rental remains open until staff check it in the next morning. What pickup and return times do you want me to price?
Pick it up at 10:00 Monday morning and return it by 4:00 Thursday. I do not want an after-hours return hanging over us.

That window is available. A standard SUV, listed as a Ford Edge or similar, is $284.17 complete with taxes and fees, pay later and cancellable until pickup. It seats five and has enough cargo room for three travelers, luggage, and beach gear. The branch is 3.4 miles from Mission Bay Resort. Would you like me to compare the smaller category before reserving it?
No. Keep the standard SUV. What do the airport rides add, and account for hotel parking only while we actually have the car.

A prebooked private transfer from SAN to Mission Bay Resort after the June 20 arrival is $64.50, including taxes and airport fees. The June 27 hotel-to-SAN transfer is $72.40. Three nights of resort parking add $138. The revised transportation total is $559.07 before fuel and driver tips: $284.17 rental, $136.90 in airport transfers, and $138 parking.
Check the timing against the flights, especially the ride back to the airport.

The inbound transfer is scheduled for the American arrival at 10:18 a.m. on June 20; the service tracks the flight and includes 45 minutes of complimentary airport waiting time. For the June 27 departure at 1:05 p.m., a 9:45 a.m. hotel pickup is available. That allows about 25 minutes to SAN and leaves roughly three hours before departure under normal traffic.
That is more airport time than we need. Can they pick us up at 10:15?

Yes. A 10:15 a.m. pickup is available at the same $72.40 price. The estimated airport arrival is 10:40 a.m., about two hours and 25 minutes before departure. The vehicle accommodates three passengers and the luggage count on the reservation.
Good. Before you book, confirm there is no gap on the rental days. How do we get from the resort to Enterprise and back?

Enterprise offers complimentary local pickup from Mission Bay Resort during branch hours. They will collect you in the resort lobby at 9:30 a.m. on June 22. After the 4:00 p.m. return on June 25, the branch shuttle will take all three of you back to the resort. Both rides are included, so no additional transfer is needed between the hotel and branch.
Book the SUV and both airport transfers, and cancel the airport rental. Do not touch the flights or resort.

I can complete that change. The original airport SUV A6R29481 will be cancelled without a fee. The replacement rental is pay later at $284.17, and the two airport transfers total $136.90 charged now. Shall I proceed with all three transactions?

Completed. Enterprise standard SUV confirmation EPM-731846 is set for June 22 at 10:00 a.m. through June 25 at 4:00 p.m., with resort pickup at 9:30 a.m. and a branch shuttle back after return. The $284.17 total is pay later and cancellable until pickup. Airport transfer confirmations are SDT-620518 for the tracked June 20 arrival and SDT-627104 for the June 27 pickup at 10:15 a.m.; $136.90 was charged. Airport rental A6R29481 was cancelled with no fee. With three parking nights, transportation is now $559.07 before fuel and tips, and the revised San Diego trip total is $6,296.99 before fuel and tips. The American flights and Mission Bay reservation were unchanged.
